question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ample
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sufficient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Ample" **means adequate or more than enough in size, extent, capacity, or quantity. It refers to a large amount that is usually enough to achieve a purpose. (पर्याप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The house has ample space for a large family.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym **"Sufficient"** refers to being enough in quantity or quality; adequate. It denotes having or providing as much as is needed. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The data is sufficient to draw a conclusion.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Sufficient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Entertain:** This word means to provide amusement for. (मनोरंजन करना)
 
• **Sample: **This noun means a small part of anything that shows what the rest is like. (नमूना)
 
• **Temple: **A place for the worship of a divine being or beings. (मंदिर)
